title: The Imperial Dynasty's Hidden Card
next_chapter_hook: Just as the three envoys were locked in a stalemate, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly shuddered violently, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out an unprecedented cry of alarm—'How can it be here?!'

text.content: Just as Chen Ji thought everything had settled, that voice from the void rang out again—'Our meeting is fate, the location is your choice.' Before the words finished, the inn's four walls became transparent, as if they were no longer in a mortal dwelling but in a glazed palace suspended above the nine heavens. Chen Ji's pupils slightly narrowed, yet he showed no trace of panic. He slowly rose, even wearing a hint of playful smile at the corners of his lips—the chess game had reached this point, might as well see what final variables could be played.

dialogue.content: (Standing with hands behind his back, his tone aloof) Since you're so sincere, let it be here then. But—(his gaze scanning the transparent walls) shouldn't the roles of host and guest be clearly defined?

text.content: The moment the words fell, a figure emerged from the depths of the glazed palace. The person wore a black-gold brocade robe, surrounded by faint golden law patterns, each radiating a suffocating heavenly Dao aura. Su Qingyao's sword was already unsheathed three inches, but that overwhelming pressure forced her knuckles pale; Ye Qing's demonic path mists churned violently, yet couldn't hide the shock in her pupils—this pressure far exceeded any demonic path great one she had witnessed, even transcending all her understanding of what it meant to be 'strong'.

dialogue.content: (His voice calm as an ancient well, yet seemingly carrying eons of time) No matter. From today onward, this world's chessboard... will be jointly held by this one and you.
(Eyebrows slightly raised, his smile deepening) Jointly held? What bold words. I wonder by what strength, what status, one might claim such 'joint stewardship'?

text.content: The figure in dark robes approached slowly, each step transforming the glazed floor beneath into chaotic void, with fragments of heavenly Dao laws faintly visible within. He stopped three zhang away from Chen Ji, finally revealing his true form—a face utterly devoid of expression, with a vertical golden eye branded at his brow center, resembling the legendary 'Eye of Heavenly Dao'.

dialogue.content: (His vertical eye slightly opened, golden light flowing) This one represents the 'Heavenly Fate Imperial Dynasty', an existence above the heavenly realm—the Seventh Divine Emissary under the Heavenly Emperor's seat, governing mortal karmic cycles. The Tianji Record in your hands is merely one of the pieces the Heavenly Emperor granted for the mortal chess game. And you...(his gaze lingering on Chen Ji) have been marked as a 'critical variable'.

(The demonic path mists suddenly gathered, his voice bearing rare trembling) The Heavenly Emperor's... Seventh Divine Emissary?! Impossible, the heavenly realm closed its passage to the mortal world ten thousand years ago—!

(Giving Ye Qing a dismissive glance) Closed? Merely a temporary recess in the chess game. Demon Path Saint, who do you think truly governs behind the Holy Sect? This one's visit is not the time to settle accounts with you.(Turning his gaze back to Chen Ji) Chen Ji, this one offers you an opportunity—the Heavenly Fate Imperial Dynasty can grant you power to break through the heavenly Dao, allowing you to transcend the shackles of this realm. In exchange, you merely need to... join us.
(Letting out a cold hum, his sword light surging) Power to break through the heavenly Dao? Sounds tempting indeed. But I wonder what price this 'tempting' offer carries?

text.content: The Seventh Divine Emissary's vertical eye finally showed a hint of approval, yet not directed at Su Qingyao's question, but at Chen Ji. That gaze seemed to be examining a precious artifact, or perhaps watching prey about to enter the net.

dialogue.content: (His voice as flat as describing the weather) Price? Merely incorporating you into the Heavenly Fate sequence, becoming a piece on the Imperial Dynasty's chessboard. Your Tianji Record Fragment was always incomplete—and this one can let you see the complete game. Well? This condition... is far more benevolent than the 'fate manipulation' of the Eye of Heavenly Dao.

(Suddenly letting out a light laugh, the sound carrying three parts mockery) Benevolent? You speak as if I'm getting the better end of this deal. But—(narrowing his eyes) I'd like to ask, what condition did the Eye of Heavenly Dao offer? You mentioned it just now, surely you won't dodge the subject?

text.content: Before the words finished, a cold hum echoed from the depths of the void, as if some slumbering existence had been awakened. Meanwhile, a contract seal materialized within the demonic path mists beside Ye Qing—the 'Concordance Pact' of the Demon Path Holy Sect. The auras of three powers clashed and collided within the glazed palace, pressing this small space until it quivered on the verge of collapse.

choice.prompt: With three powers applying simultaneous pressure, Chen Ji must respond. How should he face this unprecedented situation?

choices.text: Meeting force with force, turning the tables
choices.description: Directly questioning the Seventh Divine Emissary's authenticity, using the Tianji Record Fragment's power to probe the other's limits. Extreme risk, but could establish negotiation advantage in one stroke.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 points of Heavenly Fate for Tianji divination
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence on the Seventh Divine Emissary's true strength
choices.risk_hint: May expose part of the Tianji Record's abilities, attracting covetous attention from more powers

text.content: The moment Chen Ji's words fell, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly grew scalding hot, an impulse to peer into heavenly secrets surging in his heart. Without hesitation, he guided that familiar power to envelop the Seventh Divine Emissary—in an instant, countless fragmented images flooded his mind: golden light, chains, a massive vertical eye, and... a crack.

choices.text: Strategic retreat to advance, feigning compliance while calculating
choices.description: Pretending interest in all three conditions, guiding them to expose each other's cards, profiting from their conflict. Demonstrating Chen Ji's consistent style of playing dumb while tiger-baiting.
choices.visible_cost: Having to deal with probing from three sides simultaneously, both body and mind exhausted
choices.visible_reward: Gather intelligence and weaknesses from all three sides
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, would offend all three powers at once

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyelids, wearing an expression of 'I need to consider,' and slowly spoke: 'Your esteemed attention is beyond my humble merits. But this decision is momentous—might I hear the conditions of... the other two?' Before the words finished, the Seventh Divine Emissary's vertical eye narrowed slightly, and the cold snort from the depths of the Void grew louder.

choices.text: Declare independence, accepted by none of the three sides
choices.description: Directly reject all recruitment attempts, asserting personal control over the chessboard. The boldest choice, risking simultaneous hostility from all three.
choices.visible_cost: Lose support from potential allies, may face suppression
choices.visible_reward: Establish an image of absolute independence before the three sides
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Fate Dynasty's attitude will undergo a major transformation

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile particularly glaring under the watchful eyes of three parties. He stood with hands behind his back, voice not loud yet clearly reaching everyone's ears: 'I truly appreciate your kindness, but—this game, I have no desire to enter anyone's scheme.' The moment the words fell, the Glazed Hall violently trembled, and the Seventh Divine Emissary's vertical eye contracted into a thin line.

dialogue.content: (The vertical eye completely closes, voice carrying coldness for the first time) Not enter the game? Chen Ji, do you think you have a choice? From the moment you obtained the Tianji Record, you have been a chess piece—whether you wish it or not.

(Meeting that oppressive gaze without dodging, a cold smile反而勾起) A chess piece? That depends on whether the chess player... has the ability to swallow this 'river-crossing pawn' of mine. Since you represent the Heavenly Fate Dynasty, surely you know—even a river-crossing pawn can serve as a chariot.

choice.prompt: The situation is tense, Chen Ji needs to make a crucial decision—how will he face simultaneous recruitment from these three cosmic-level beings?

choices.description: Accept all information from the three sides but promise nothing, using time differences to maximize benefits. A typical strategy of using stillness to overcome movement.
choices.visible_cost: Consume enormous energy to juggle three parties
choices.visible_reward: Simultaneously gain partial resources and intelligence from all three parties
choices.risk_hint: May be seen as a opportunistic opportunist

text.content: Chen Ji slightly nodded, speaking with perfectly measured composure: 'Your esteemed attention flatters me greatly. Perhaps this—your kindness, I will keep in mind. Let me carefully consider, then give you my answer?' These words were watertight, offending no party while leaving room for future flexibility.

choices.text: Secretly take sides, keep trump cards hidden
choices.description: Choose to secretly ally with one party while using resources from the other two to strengthen oneself. The safest approach but may lose independent status.
choices.visible_cost: Need to hide true stance, lying is mentally exhausting
choices.visible_reward: Obtain secret support from a powerful faction
choices.risk_hint: If alliance choice is wrong, it will be irretrievable

text.content: Chen Ji weighed the pros and cons rapidly in his heart, his gaze inadvertently sweeping toward Ye Qing. That subtle movement was caught by the Seventh Divine Emissary, a glint of amusement flashing in the vertical eye. And within Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist, the contract mark silently transformed—some deeper level of understanding was taking shape.

dialogue.content: (Voice transmission, with rare anxiety) "Chen Ji, whatever you decide... be careful. This Seventh Divine Envoy's aura is more terrifying than any senior I've encountered in the Tianqing Sect. If he truly wants to strike, we have no chance of victory."

(Voice transmission, solemn tone) "What he says is true. The master behind the Holy Sect... I always thought it was the Demon Path Supreme, but now it seems we've all been deceived. Chen Ji, I need your Tianji Record's ability—help me see the Holy Sect's true layout. In exchange, the Demon Path Mist can help conceal all your aura."

(A meaningful smile curves his lips as he transmits a reply to both) "Your kindness, I appreciate. However—(turning to the Seventh Divine Envoy) since you call me a 'key variable,' you surely understand that a key variable's value... lies in its ability to change the chess game's direction. Do you truly believe that using 'commands' can make this piece willingly serve you?"

choice.prompt: The three forces stand at a stalemate, and Chen Ji must make his final decision—his next move will determine the entire situation's direction.

choices.text: Verify on the spot whether the complete Tianji Record exists
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record Fragment to deduce the 'complete chess game' mentioned by the Seventh Divine Envoy, probing the Heavenly Fate Dynasty's true intentions. Extremely high risk, but could uncover all mysteries at once.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 30 Heavenly Fate points (current Heavenly Fate may be insufficient)
choices.visible_reward: May see the truth of the complete Tianji Record and the Heavenly Fate Dynasty's core secrets
choices.risk_hint: Insufficient Heavenly Fate will cause backlash, potentially causing immediate unconsciousness

text.content: Chen Ji no longer hesitates, his palm spreading open. The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly bursts with blinding light. That power of prying into Heavenly Secrets surges again—this time not directed at the Seventh Divine Envoy, but extending toward the 'complete chess game.' In an instant, countless visions flood into his divine soul like a torrent: the resplendent Golden Heaven, the chessboard bound by countless chains, and a Heavenly Dao's eye slowly opening...

choices.text: Announce accepting information from all three parties without making commitments
choices.description: Express stance: willing to listen to all three parties' intelligence and conditions, but reserve the right to final choice. Most aligned with Chen Ji's consistent 'maneuvering' style.
choices.visible_cost: Need to simultaneously handle follow-up probing from all three parties
choices.visible_reward: Maintain maximum freedom, leaving space for future arrangements
choices.risk_hint: May be seen by all three parties as an opportunist waiting for the best offer

text.content: Chen Ji surveys the three factions, a composed smile slowly spreading across his lips. He clasps his hands in a slight bow, his voice neither loud nor soft yet crystal clear: "Your esteemed favors, Chen Ji is unworthy of. However—since all of you have come seeking me, you surely each have your own筹码. Why not this way: each of you first state your sincerity and conditions, and Chen Ji will listen attentively. As for the final choice..." He pauses, a glint of cunning flickering in his gaze, "The time will naturally bring clarity."

choices.text: Leave with a sweep of his sleeves, making no commitments whatsoever
choices.description: Leave directly, declaring that his destiny is under his own control. The boldest and most dangerous choice, may incur simultaneous hostility from all three parties.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all potential ally support, facing pressure from all three factions
choices.visible_reward: Establish an absolutely uncontrollable image before the three parties, which may instead earn respect
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Fate Dynasty may resort to forced measures

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly turns around, sweeping his sleeves as if about to leave. His voice is calm yet carries unyielding resolve: "Your kindness, Chen Ji appreciates. But this chess game—" He glances back, his gaze sweeping over the Seventh Divine Envoy, the Void's depths, and Ye Qing in turn, "Chen Ji will play himself." The moment his words fall, the glazed hall shatters with a thunderous crash, and three terrifying auras surge upward simultaneously.

As the three factions' envoys stand in a standoff, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly trembles violently. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul lets out an unprecedented cry—"How could it be here?!" The voice carries unmistakable terror, as if witnessing something that should never exist in this world. At the same moment, the Seventh Divine Envoy's vertical eye suddenly opens wide, golden pupils reflecting a blurry image—a figure sealed by countless chains, bearing a striking seven-tenths resemblance to Chen Ji.
